verdict.rationale: There is scattered evidence of batch-like actions (multi-check deposit, package bundling, automation rules for mail handling) and an API/Zapier integration for workflow automation, but no documentation of true bulk operations (e.g., batch API calls across many mailbox items) and the OpenAPI/dev docs probes all 404, so no confirmed programmatic bulk endpoint exists. missing for 10: documented API endpoints supporting bulk/batch actions, evidence of bulk operations beyond checks/packages (e.g., mail scans, forwarding requests), and independent confirmation of bulk automation via Zapier or API.
